replies.text: I'm Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic. I can read and write text and code, look at images and documents, and use tools that you give me. I don't remember earlier conversations unless you send them again, and I can be wrong, so check what matters.

replies.text: I can't know that: I have no access to the news, and my knowledge stops at my training cutoff. Give me the articles, or use a tool such as web search, and I can summarise them.
